other_conditions: Applicant must be the legal heir of the deceased fisherman.
Deceased fisherman must have been an active fisherman from Gujarat.
Death must be due to death in Pakistan Jail, loss at sea, or accidental death while fishing at sea.
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time financial assistance of ₹4,00,000 for death in Pakistan jail and ₹2,00,000 for loss at sea or accidental death while fishing.
